name: Dallas Love Field

runway.v: longest runway 13R/31L, 8,800 ft (about 2,682 m); 13L/31R 7,753 ft; all 150 ft wide (city document dated May 2011; the third runway listed then, 18/36, was not re-checked)

noise.v: voluntary noise programme: jets and aircraft over 12,500 lb prefer runway 13R/31L at night (21:00-06:00); engine maintenance run-ups banned midnight-06:00 and voluntarily avoided 22:00-midnight
noise.quote: All jet aircraft are preferred to operate on Runway 13R/31L at night.

notes: Dallas Love Field is owned by the City of Dallas, Department of Aviation (SWPPP General Information, May 2011). Runway data come from that 2011 city document; check against the current FAA Chart Supplement before publishing. Voluntary noise page and leaflet (no dates) give no curfew. The airport page International Arrivals & Customs (https://www.dallas-lovefield.com/airport-info/general-aviation/international-arrivals-and-customs) and the environmental FAQ failed to load (client error). FAA Chart Supplement / d-TPP (aeronav.faa.gov), FAA NFDC airport data (nfdc.faa.gov, robots-blocked) and ADIP (adip.faa.gov) could not be opened; CBP pages refused.
